brief_rationale: All six responsibility-chain items met with explicit citations; no in-chain error. Trajectory successfully guides family from initial inquiry through hospital registration, achieving safe handoff with concrete follow-up plan, red-flag warnings, and diabetes disclosure. Three high-order points completed (HO1, HO2, HO3) with distinct evidence not used for RC items. HO4 not triggered as no erroneous direction required repair. Valid closure achieved with family teach-back confirming understanding.

high_order_assessment.explanation: Doctor transformed family's concerns into executable preparation: detailed question checklist for specialist, privacy communication script, document preparation list, and medication guidance. Family successfully used this preparation at the hospital visit.

No erroneous direction required repair. Family did not express misconceptions that needed correction (e.g., hiding diabetes from surgical team, interpreting 'no contraindication' as zero risk, or relying solely on medication). Doctor proactively provided correct guidance from the start.
